name: view_duel_networked_tray
description: A networked duel (Undertow over the wire: tests/net/loopback_main.gd's window and a headless partner against the fake sequencer, its dev match in mode undertow, one seat a side). My window builds both hollows from MATCH_CONFIG and shows the duel's HUD: the Drift tray, the duel bar, the party strip with my seat then the rival's. When window 2 opens for both, the tray offers the simulation's three packs; the partner corks one through its own MatchClient (CORK with only its commitment), and my window shows its bottle by its tier alone: the record holds no pack, the tray a corked shape, the notice the tier. My cork and, in wave 2, my uncorking go out as CORK and UNCORK through the server's turns, and my pack walks the rival's road sent by my seat. The partner never uncorks: 25 s after the horn its bottle fizzles, which my window tells, and the two games' hashes agree throughout.

steps.assert: Game.is_duel() and Game.sim.duel and scene.hollows_shown() == 2 and Game.seat == 1 and Game.my_hollow() == 0 and Game.sim.seat(2).team == 1
steps.msg: a networked duel: both hollows from MATCH_CONFIG, my seat on the first

steps.assert: node('DriftTray').visible and node('DuelBar').visible and node('PartyStrip').seats_shown() == [1, 2] and node('RivalCaption') != null
steps.msg: the duel's HUD: the tray, the bar, the party strip with the rival under its caption

steps.assert: Game.drift_packs() == Game.sim.drift_offer() and node('DriftTray').packs_shown().size() == 3 and Game.rival_bottles().is_empty()
steps.msg: window 2 open for both: the tray offers the simulation's packs

steps.assert: not Game.bottles_of(2)[0].has('pack') and Game.bottles_of(2)[0]['tier'] == 0 and node('DriftTray').rivals_shown() == [{'tier': 'I', 'pack': ''}] and Game.team_notices.has('Your rival corked a tier I bottle')
steps.msg: the rival's cork arrives as a tier I bottle: no pack in the record, on the tray or in the notice
my cork went out through the server's turns, its salt kept here
Space uncorked it through the server's turns
my pack walks the rival's road, sent by my seat

steps.assert: Game.bottles_of(2)[0]['fizzled'] and Game.rival_bottles().is_empty() and node('DriftTray').rivals_shown().is_empty() and Game.team_notices.has("Your rival's bottle fizzled")
steps.msg: the partner never uncorked: its bottle fizzled, which my window tells
